candidate_claims.surface_definition: A versioned map connecting logical units and composed fragments across scales, with stable IDs, typed edges, parent links, provenance, constraints, counterexamples and status metadata.

A condition intended to remain true when validated logical fragments are composed at a higher scale, such as typed interface compatibility, stable parent IDs, source lineage, and preserved constraints.

boundary: Definitions are kept as source-linked surface text. No AST, premise, conclusion, proof, or entailment has been invented. A reviewer or a configured proposer must draft a formal representation that passes the formal-fragment contract.
